65:9 · 065 At-Talaq

فَذَاقَتْ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهَا وَكَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ أَمْرِهَا خُسْرًا

Word in this verse: خُسْرًا — loss

English (Sahih International): And it tasted the bad consequence of its affair [i.e., rebellion], and the outcome of its affair was loss.

English (Yusuf Ali): Then did they taste the evil result of their conduct, and the End of their conduct was Perdition.

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): سو انہوں نے اپنے کاموں کی سزا کا مزہ چکھ لیا اور ان کا انجام نقصان ہی تو تھا

إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ

Word in this verse: خُسْرٍ — loss

English (Sahih International): Indeed, mankind is in loss,

English (Yusuf Ali): Verily Man is in loss,

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): کہ انسان نقصان میں ہے
